I don’t have access to the VirusTotal API to fetch the actual IDs for *sample.com*.  
To obtain the CNAME record IDs yourself, call the domain endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

In the JSON response, look for the `cname` field (or the `cname` objects under the `attributes` section). Each CNAME object will contain an `id` field – those are the IDs you’re looking for.
